name: Guided Korean lesson
title_zh: 韩语陪练先问清你读到第几页，再决定说多难
tagline_zh: 不按教材等级硬套——先探测你的阅读深度，再切换句式和词汇。适合已经能读新闻却总被简单对话卡住的学习者。
tagline_en: No fixed textbook levels—it probes how much you can read, then tunes sentence complexity. For learners who read.
desc_en: Run a focused Korean conversation, lesson, practice session, quiz, or study plan using state-aware language suited to a highly literate learner.
why_zh: 状态感知是核心：它根据你当前能读多难的内容动态调整语言层级，而不是固定按TOPIK分级。
why_en: State-aware: it adapts language difficulty to your demonstrated reading ability, not a static TOPIK band. Like a tutor who tests.
limit_zh: 只覆盖韩语对话/练习/测验/学习计划四类场景；不教发音、不批改写作；需要你已有一定阅读基础（能读短文）。
limit_en: Only covers conversation/practice/quiz/study plans. No pronunciation or writing feedback. Requires basic reading ability—useless for absolute.
title_en: Korean tutor that checks your reading level before.
